notes.title: Free Content Update coming soon!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Munchers![/b]
To show my appreciate for all of you, there will be a free content update for Earth Muncher!! There will be plenty more levels, some new baddies, new obstacles, and treasures that await Norm. 

Stay tuned for more info!
